summary: The change is a minimal, spec-faithful implementation of DataView.prototype.getFloat32. Step 1 binds this to view, and step 2 defaults littleEndian to false when fewer than two arguments are passed. Step 3 delegates to the shared get_view_value helper with ElementType::Float32, and the error path is propagated with `?` by returning its result. Step comments are kept above the code. The only other edit is renaming the unused new_target parameter to _new_target, which is needed to keep clippy clean. No test-specific branches, no swallowed errors, and no made-up values. The gate's +36 test262 flips are plausible for a one-line delegation to a helper that implements GetViewValue for all types. Caveat: the body of get_view_value is in a support file outside this diff, so I did not verify that it performs GetViewValue steps 1 through 13 in full. That should be checked when the helper is reviewed.
